correctness.rationale: PASS. For all b>=2 and all positive digit lengths L, reconstruct right-aligned base-b^3 blocks. If L divisible by three, combining palindrome of whole base-b digit string and the reversal of three-digit block list forces each block to be palindromic and the block sequence to be palindromic, yielding (b-1)*b^(2*ceil(q/2)-1). For L=3q+1, the short leading block numeric value matches the final full block (0,0,a_0); whole-word reversal and successive block comparisons force every index congruent to 1 or 2 mod 3 to vanish and leave a palindromic list of q+1 letters; similarly 3q+2 forces equal digit pairs separated by zeroes. Leading digit nonzero handles standard representation. Independent direct conversion + enumeration agrees in 36 (b,L) profiles b=2 L<=17, b=3 L<=11, b=4 L<=8. The rational GF separates q parity; length layers sum to Theta_b(X^(1/3)). The finite checks do not establish the unrestricted theorem.
